facts.text: Through the Colby Commitment, Colby meets 100% of demonstrated need without loans. Families earning $75,000 or less with typical assets pay $0, and families earning up to $150,000 pay no more than $15,000.

sources.title: The Colby Commitment - Colby College Admissions

facts.text: Through DavisConnects, Colby guarantees all students access to funding for research, internship, and global experiences regardless of their ability to pay.

sources.title: The Colby Commitment - Colby College Admissions
